title: Deep Spec normalized findings (contract 2)
description: Per-backend verification result file, written to <record>/<phase>/<stage>/deep-spec-verify/<backend>.json. Canonically sorted, byte-deterministic for a given IR and environment. Nothing is silently dropped: every obligation or scenario a backend did not check appears in skipped[] with a reason.

backend.description: Backend identifier; equals the findings file basename without .json.

irVersion.description: irVersion of the consumed IR document.

irHash.description: sha256 of the canonical (key-sorted) JSON serialization of the consumed IR. Cross-checking only compares sibling findings files with an identical irHash.

method.description: exhaustive: full symbolic check (SMT). bounded: bounded model checking (Quint+Apalache). simulation: seeded random simulation (quint run).

unavailable.description: Present when the backend could not run at all (solver missing, runtime missing, IR unreadable). The stage treats every obligation as unverified by this backend.

crossChecked.description: Which sibling backends were compared, and on which targets. Records the cross-check surface even when no disagreement was found (no-silence).

frRefs.description: FR/NFR ids implicated, sorted, deduplicated. Traces the finding back to requirements.md.

oneOf.description: A single state (attribute path -> value) demonstrating the finding.
A step-execution trace (state sequence) demonstrating the finding.
An unsat core: the minimal implicated constraint labels (obligation/background/type-bound ids).

reason.description: capability: outside this backend's nature/feature coverage. compile-error: could not be compiled to the backend language. ir-version-mismatch: IR major version unsupported. timeout: per-obligation or per-run budget exhausted. unavailable: solver/runtime absent.
